cross-region-fallback.reason: The game still starts without the precise file, on another region's BIOS with a warning.
cross-region-fallback.title: Missing region file replaced by another region's image

duckstation-custom-region.reason: A region the user set for one game in the game list replaces the region read from the disc.
duckstation-custom-region.title: Per-game custom region

first-disc-region.reason: For a multi-disc game the region is read from disc 1 alone.
first-disc-region.title: Only the first disc sets the region

psx-override-bios.reason: An option swaps in a region-free image for every region.
psx-override-bios.title: Region-free override BIOS

user-region-option.reason: The forced region decides the file, and the option is device state the installer does not read.
user-region-option.title: A core option forces the console region

beetle_psx.note: The fallback is psx.region_default, north-america unless the core option says otherwise. Only the first disc of a playlist sets the region.

sources.serial_note: Serials are written as the DAT writes them, and the DAT uses both forms: 'SLES-01971' and 'SLPS 02251' in the PlayStation DAT of the same day. A core reads the serial from the disc in its own spelling (SYSTEM.CNF holds 'SLPS_022.51', DuckStation reports 'SLPS-02251'). No source fixes a rule joining the two, so the comparison rule is the reader's to state.
